posts.title: August 2026
posts.description: In northern Spain, still awestruck after last weeks' total Eclipse. Reading Jane Jacobs' The Death and Life of Great American Cities . Enjoying the little things: dog walks, bike rides up the hills, times with loved ones and eating lots of blueberries.

posts.description: I’m Guille. You may also know me as guillego. I'm a telecom-turned-biomedical-turned-software engineer . posts.title: April 2026
posts.description: In Copenhagen, enjoying the arrival of spring. The days are long, the harbour ice is gone, and the first bike rides without a jacket and gloves feel delightful.
